review_scope: Bounded source review and synthetic tests of the private MsPacman/Asteroids CPU chain after the two review findings were closed.

checks.history: Native snapshot keeps include_rng=True state, two RGB buffers, sticky RNG state and last action; new private fifth element keeps independent copies of all three RAM arrays, adjacent frame numbers and action count. Import validates native current frame/RAM and initial duplicate conventions; direct native restore bypass is rejected. Ledger is excluded from snapshots and remains monotone.
checks.advance_identity: New _advance AST equals the sealed inherited implementation after removing its sole post-payment/post-RGB callback and normalizing only explanatory RuntimeError text. Native act, elapsed check, sticky choice/state, terminal truncation and charging order otherwise match.
checks.failures: One real frame executed before a decoder error is paid and its RGB preserved. Experimental decoder failure additionally charges its restoring operation and returns native/RGB/sticky/history to anchor. The corrected visible engine permanently rejects further steps after any exception; report remains available with original failure type.
checks.transport: The server accepts only step/report/close and rejects RAM, clone, restore and branch requests. Step errors travel as ValueError plus original type/message so the parent can drain all worker responses and retrieve private aggregate reports. The corrected pool refuses all subsequent action batches after the first failure.
checks.cache_and_cold: Source label cache and raw movement history are updated only by ordinary played frames. Lab callbacks decode for diagnostic cost but do not alter either. A new cold episode clears the two-source cache; its first act supplies initial RAM-derived geometry and resets movement history through the episode identifier. Terminal branches stop without fictitious acts or free cold resets.
checks.group_membership: One mask per declared category rasterizes each source rectangle once; scipy default4CC joins edge contact and overlap, not diagonal/toroidal contact. Membership from each filled rectangle top-left belongs to its unique connected component; enclosing-box holes do not create false membership. Static pills/power pills remain visible for precision and ineligible for movement.
checks.oracle_separation: RAM source labels flow only to private scene/group/motion scoring. Reference.observe receives only ordinary pooled RGB; reference.extract on branch images is read-only for background state. Changed-pixel targets and their digest are computed from intervention/control RGB only. Synthetic removal of labels leaves ordinary RGB, RGB boxes, target digest, restored state and costs unchanged.
checks.scope: Exactly two declared games, repeat4/lab mode and branch cadence128. These prepared modules are not yet a reviewed complete runner or benchmark protocol.

closed_findings.initial_witness: Native frame5 was paid but not decoded; a later successful step reached native9 while scorer/ordinary history reported8, silently bridging the missing frame.
closed_findings.resolution: Engine failure latch refuses every later step; pool failure latch refuses every later batch. Original type/error and partial cost remain readable. Independently repeated mid-episode witness now stays at native(3,4,5), ordinary4,charge605 after refusal.

closed_findings.initial_witness: Cold frame0 box x10 and first acted frame1 box x11 form pooled geometry, but moving eligibility is0 because frame0 was not observed by the scorer.
closed_findings.resolution: Parent explicitly chose the prospective convention: movement history contains ordinary acted images only; frame0 supplies geometry, and cold0-to1 is outside moving eligibility. Code comment and terminal1 test preserve visible1/eligible0/null. Carry this convention into the future protocol and result limitations.
closed_findings.closure_type: Explicit scientific scope choice, not evidence that the omitted transition has no movement.

additional_witnesses: Base-versus-new-engine synthetic comparison at terminal frames1,5,509: identical ordinary/branch RGB, three RAM, sticky state and complete ledger.
Actual dispatch with fake connection rejects getRAM/clone/restore/branch_pair; only step/report/close accepted.
Transient mid-episode decoder failure pays frame5, permanently refuses continuation, and keeps report unchanged.
Two fake worker replies are fully drained after one error; reports from both workers remain accessible; retry sends no new batch.

limitations: No emulator, ROM, fresh seed, capture, compiled-native execution, benchmark or full calibration was run. Synthetic and AST equivalence do not establish exhaustive native/ALE equivalence or throughput.

The source mapping lists the eight primary modules/tests reviewed here, with selected dependency fingerprints; it is not the final transitive closure of a future runner, compiler/backend or protocol. Final source/runtime/build/evidence sealing is still required.

After any failure, perception and decoded-frame counts are partial; physical paid frames can exceed successfully decoded frames. Consumers must reject the failed trajectory and preserve the complete aggregate cost instead of treating its report as a valid full result.
Cold frame0 contributes geometry but never movement eligibility. This declared omission must be prominent in the future protocol; empty moving denominators remain null and must not become success.

Component membership and motion use render-slot/piece keys and center changes, not proven persistent physical identities. Animation, visibility and slot reuse can affect this external metric; static pills are explicitly exempt from movement eligibility only.

Scorer sidecar restoration is established for the reviewed ordinary-step/branch_pair path. Arbitrary hidden native mutation, importing untrusted snapshot histories, or wiring other lab/reset paths is outside this review.

The optional native reference backend/build was not exercised or fully audited here. Real wiring, compiled-target invariance, benchmark scope and proof prerequisites require their own prospective review.

Old raw calibration and corrected temporal source-frame composition remain distinct evidence. No new independently validated raw judge, learned perception, transfer, acceleration, training permission or gate result is established.
The CPU corrections were made by the parent in new prepared sources; the reviewer changed no existing file, sealed source or result and made no commit.
